newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Swiss July inflation steady at 0.5 pct yr-yr.
newsitem.headline: Swiss July inflation steady at 0.5 pct yr-yr.

text.p: Swiss consumer prices fell 0.1 percent in July from June, while the Swiss year-on-year inflation rate was 0.5 percent, unchanged from June, the Federal Statistics Office said.
Monthly CPI index change -0.1 pct +0.1 pct -0.1 pct
The Statistics Office said that the slight drop in the index in July was mainly due to declines in food, beverage and tobacco prices due to seasonal factors.
Declines in transportation and communication costs were tied mainly to a drop in fuel prices.
Prices of domestic goods fell by 0.1 percent and those of imported goods by 0.3 percent compared with the previous month.
Prices of domestic goods rose by 0.5 percent on average, and those of improted goods rose by 0.7 percent in July versus July 1996. -- Zurich Editorial, +41 1 631 7340
